channel.title: Construction & Heavy Equipment India
channel.description: Industry news for construction and heavy equipment

item.title: JCB announces new AI-powered equipment diagnostics for construction sites
item.description: JCB has launched a new artificial intelligence system that provides real-time diagnostics for construction equipment. The system uses machine learning algorithms to predict maintenance needs before failures occur, reducing downtime on construction sites across India.

item.title: India's construction sector shows digital transformation with IoT sensors on heavy machinery
item.description: Major equipment manufacturers including JCB are integrating IoT and edge computing solutions into heavy machinery. These connected devices provide real-time data on equipment health, fuel consumption, and operator performance across construction projects.

item.title: JCB and competitors focus on autonomous construction equipment development
item.description: JCB is investing heavily in robotics and autonomous vehicle technology for construction sites. The company is developing equipment that can operate with minimal human intervention, utilizing AI and sensor fusion technologies.
